claims.claim: Spoken / sighted Fastnet 185 miles W of Fastnet (April 17)
claims.citation: New York Herald, 1 May 1866, p. 8, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Etna (Br), Tibbits, Liverpool, April 14, and
Queenstown 16th, with mdse and 733 passengers, to John G
Dale. April 17, 185 miles W of Fastnet, passed steamship
Louisiana; 24th, lat 43 50, lon 45 08, bark Goayer[?] Castle (Br),
bound W; 27th, lat 41 33, lon 61; 7:30 PM, a steamer bound
E, showing one blue light and one rocket; 29th, 10 AM, 233
miles E of Sandy Hook, passed steamships America, City
of Boston and Teutonia; 1 PM, steamship Hibernia, bound
East.
